result.title: What a Drop Reveals: Sim-to-Real Material Estimation for Deformable Objects from Video
result.summary: How an object deforms when it hits the ground reveals what it is made of. From a single real video of a drop, we estimate a deformable object's density-normalized stiffness $E/ρ$, and its yield stress $σ_Y/ρ$ when the impact causes plastic deformation, with a feed-forward predictor trained only in simulation. Real videos carry no material labels, so such predictors are developed and validated on synthetic data alone. We show that synthetic validation ranks their geometric inputs in the wrong order. Material acts through 3D deformation, and tracklets lifted to 3D with estimated depth are indeed the most accurate input in simulation. However, on real drops they are the least accurate, and better depth does not repair them: the failure persists with simulator depth in training, LiDAR depth at test time, and exact depth on rendered replays of the real drops. Short 2D optical-flow tracklets do the opposite: they improve nothing in simulation, yet they transfer best. Material is therefore better read from what perception measures consistently in both domains than from what is most informative in simulation. Our predictor, PhysReader, reads the video and 2D tracklets and learns the lift to 3D in simulation by matching a teacher that sees exact 3D deformation. To measure transfer, we introduce PhysReader-Real: 16 everyday objects dropped five times each, with reference materials fit jointly to each object's drops and checked against tensile tests. On PhysReader-Real, PhysReader is closer to the reference materials than every other input and baseline. The one exception is a per-scene optimizer started from PhysReader's prediction, which ends slightly closer but takes 49 minutes per video instead of 12 seconds.

AI.brief_summary: 论文从单段真实物体落地视频估计可形变材料的密度归一化刚度与屈服应力，用仅在仿真中训练的前馈预测器，并发现合成验证会把输入几何形式的优劣排错：仿真中最准的 3D 抬升 tracklet 在真实视频上最差，而 2D 光流 tracklet 反而迁移最好，据此提出 PhysReader 并构建 16 个真实物体的评测集。
AI.relevance_reason: 其核心观察「仿真中最具信息量的表征未必在真实域可用，应按两域一致可测的感知量选择视觉证据」可能为 LVR 中视觉细节保留、证据筛选与合成数据验证的可信度提供类比线索，但属远领域，需较多核查。
